title: OpenProposal example findings
description: The places where an example the specification gives fails against the emitted schemas, uses a key the model doesn't define, or breaks a rule that one payload decides, each with the decision records the failing location rests on, and the rules' checks that the examples leave undecided. The examples gate fails on a failure or an undecided check this file doesn't record, and on a recorded one that no longer occurs.

undecided.description: The rules' checks that an example's values can't decide, because the verdict turns on what the example leaves out: the proposal's seller for a line item alone, a member a code block leaves out, or a fact the text gives no field for. Each is reviewed as a finding is.

example.description: The example: a file of the specification repository, such as `examples/line-item-display.yaml`, or the IR element of a code block that a decision maps to an example, such as `code:5.5:1`.

path.description: The JSON pointer of the failing location in the example, `""` for the whole of it.

kind.description: `load`: the example doesn't load under YAML 1.2 core as JSON. `invalid`: the schema rejects the value. `undefined_key`: the model defines no such key, whether the object is closed and the schema rejects it, or open and the schema accepts it. `rule`: the check of a rule that one payload decides rejects the value (src/rule-checks.ts), and `rule` names the rule.

rule.description: The rule a `rule` finding breaks, as rules.json names it. One location can fail its schema and a rule, so the example, the path, and the rule name a finding.

severity.description: `warning` for a `rule` finding of a SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, RECOMMENDED, or NOT RECOMMENDED rule, which an implementation may depart from with a reason; a finding without it is an error. The gate compares it with the rule's level, and the feedback counts warnings apart from errors.

value.description: The example's value at the location, as `npm run examples` prints it; null for `load`. The gate compares it with the example, so a changed example needs a fresh review.

decisions.description: The decision records the failing location rests on, one per cause: a failure with two causes, such as a readable ID and an unlisted term in one option, cites both. Each covers an element of the deepest model type or property at the location.

reason.description: Why the example fails there, in one to three sentences. Where a cause is a change we propose (a `departure` record), the example follows the text, so the reason starts "The example follows the text", says what the example writes, and says what we propose, with "We propose"; it never says the example or the specification should change. Where every cause is a `gap` record, the reason says where the example disagrees with the text, and which side should change.

locks.description: Lock names the finding occurs on. Without it, it occurs on every lock.

example.description: The example, as a finding names it.

path.description: The JSON pointer of the value the rule reads, `""` for the whole example.

rule.description: The rule whose check can't decide, as rules.json names it.

decisions.description: The decision records that say why the check can't decide: each covers an element the rule rests on.

reason.description: What the verdict turns on that the example leaves out, in one or two sentences.

locks.description: Lock names the check is undecided on. Without it, on every lock.
